rules_primary: If the annual percent change in U.S. current-dollar gross domestic product for calendar year 2027 is above 1.5%, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
The Underlying is the 2027 annual value for GDP under “Current-dollar measures” in the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis release titled “GDP (Advance Estimate), 4th Quarter and Year 2027,” or its equivalent successor publication.

The value will be taken as reported by BEA, in percentage terms and to the precision published by BEA. Subsequent estimates, revisions, annual updates, or benchmark revisions will not affect resolution.
